official_sources.title: Overseas Employment Corporation, Pakistan (EPS sending agency)

notes: EPS workers are hired government-to-government; private agents promising a "guaranteed" EPS job for a fee are a known scam. Go through your country's official sending agency.

visa_routes.name: Employment Permit System (E-9)
visa_routes.summary: A government-to-government programme. Workers pass the EPS-TOPIK Korean test and a skills check, then join a job-seeker roster that Korean employers choose from.

steps.title: Register through your official sending agency
steps.description: In Pakistan this is the Overseas Employment Corporation. Do not pay private agents for EPS.

steps.title: Pass EPS-TOPIK
steps.description: The Korean language test for EPS.

steps.title: Skills and competency check
steps.description: Some sectors add a skills test.

steps.title: Job-seeker roster and employer selection
steps.description: Korean employers pick workers from the roster and sign a standard labour contract.

steps.title: Visa issuance and pre-departure training
steps.description: The visa is issued after the contract; complete training before departure.

requirements.title: Age 18 to 39
requirements.description: EPS applicants are expected to be between 18 and 39.

requirements.title: Pass EPS-TOPIK
requirements.description: The pass mark is set per test round; check the current round's notice.
